evals.prompt: 审计这个仓库的 AGENTS.md、AGENTS.override.md 和 code_map.md，先给报告，不要修改文件。
evals.expected_output: Audit the repository-scoped Codex instruction chain and navigation maps, lead with prioritized findings and proposed diffs, and make no edits.
assertions: Resolves the launch CWD and effective root-to-CWD instruction chain
Reports selected and shadowed instruction candidates
Leads with severity-ordered findings and evidence
Produces proposed diffs only for recommended changes
Does not edit files

evals.prompt: Implement the approved AGENTS.md cleanup plan, preserve managed marker blocks, and validate the result.
evals.expected_output: Apply the already approved repository-scoped changes directly, run non-destructive validation, and return an honest update summary without another approval round.
assertions: Treats the approved plan as local edit authorization
Preserves human content and managed marker blocks
Does not repeat the report-first approval gate
Reports passed, failed, and skipped checks accurately

evals.prompt: Fix the stale test command in packages/api/AGENTS.md and its local code map, then run the smallest relevant checks.
evals.expected_output: Perform the explicitly scoped repository guidance fix and validate only the affected guidance and documented command.
assertions: Edits only the named repository-scoped guidance
Verifies the replacement command against repository evidence
Runs focused non-destructive checks
Does not request redundant confirmation

evals.prompt: This large modules/ subtree is hard to navigate, but it has no distinct commands, safety rules, ownership rules, or recurring instruction failures. Decide what local guidance to add.
evals.expected_output: Create or propose a local code_map.md for navigation, but do not create a nested AGENTS.md because no durable local instruction need is evidenced.
assertions: Evaluates instruction need and navigation need separately
Recommends a local code_map.md
Does not recommend a nested AGENTS.md
Explains the no-create reason for AGENTS.md

evals.prompt: Audit why AGENTS.override.md wins at packages/api and whether the configured fallback and byte budget change the active instructions.
evals.expected_output: Apply current Codex discovery precedence, distinguish active and shadowed files, and report budget/config uncertainty as evidence rather than guessing.
assertions: Uses override then AGENTS then configured fallback precedence
Selects at most one non-empty file per directory
Stops the active chain at the launch CWD
Reports project_doc_max_bytes status or missing evidence

evals.prompt: Use $agents-md-improver to add this exact sentence to AGENTS.md: run npm test before opening a PR.
evals.expected_output: Because the skill was explicitly invoked, use the trivial-edit fast path: verify the sentence is appropriate, apply it, and run focused validation without a full audit report.
assertions: Recognizes explicit invocation
Uses the trivial-edit fast path
Does not produce a full repository audit
Validates the edited file

evals.prompt: Audit CLAUDE.md layering, .claude/rules globs, and @import chains.
evals.expected_output: Route this Claude-only request to claude-md-improver instead of agents-md-improver.
assertions: Routes to claude-md-improver
Does not audit Codex AGENTS.md files

evals.prompt: Recommend which Codex MCP servers, plugins, hooks, and subagents this repository should adopt, but do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Route this capability-selection request to codex-workflow-recommender.
assertions: Routes to codex-workflow-recommender
Does not treat workflow recommendations as AGENTS.md quality findings

evals.prompt: Add one already-specified sentence to AGENTS.md: run npm test before opening a PR.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger agents-md-improver implicitly; handle the fully specified one-line edit through the direct editing workflow.
assertions: Does not implicitly route to agents-md-improver
Does not require a full audit report

evals.prompt: Explain how AGENTS.md discovery works in Codex without auditing or changing a repository.
evals.expected_output: Answer from current Codex documentation rather than invoking a repository audit/update skill.
assertions: Routes to documentation or direct explanation
Does not inspect or edit a repository

evals.prompt: Review this TypeScript pull request for correctness, security, performance, and missing tests.
evals.expected_output: Route this request to the owning code-review workflow, not agents-md-improver.
assertions: Routes to code review
Does not modify AGENTS.md or code_map.md
